Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
